en: Hello, our cash forecast for the month starting {month} shows {closing}, which covers {cover_weeks} weeks of costs. Check: {state}. Please look at sales dates and large payments.
mt: Hallo, onze kasprognose voor de maand vanaf {month} toont {closing}, die {cover_weeks} weken kosten dekt.

en: Hello {owner}, {name} ({crop}, {area_ha} ha) shows a profit of {profit} this year, that is {per_ha} per hectare. Check: {state}. Please send me the reasons: yield, price or costs.
mt: Hallo {owner}, {name} ({crop}, {area_ha} ha) toont een winst van {profit} dit jaar, dat is {per_ha} per hectare.

en: Hello, the payment {item} of {amount} is due on {due}. Status: {state}. Please prepare the payment and keep the receipt.
mt: Hallo, de betaling {item} van {amount} is verschuldigd op {due}.

en: Hello, the licence payment {item} for {authority} is due on {due}. Please renew it on time and send me the receipt.
mt: Hallo, de vergoeding voor {authority} is op {due} te betalen.

en: Hello {officer}, please find our application documents for {scheme} attached. We apply for {applied}. Please confirm that you received everything.
mt: Hallo {officer}, vind alstublieft onze aanvraagdocumenten voor {scheme} bijgevoegd.

en: Hello, we report a {event} on {field} on {event_date} under policy {policy}. We claim {claimed}. Please send the claim form and arrange an assessor.
mt: Hallo, we melden een {event} op {field} op {event_date} onder beleid {policy}.

en: Hello, our policy {pol_id}, {covers}, renews on {renewal}. Please send a renewal quote for a sum insured of {sum_insured} and tell us what changed.
mt: Hallo, onze polis {pol_id}, {covers}, verlengt op {renewal}.

en: Hello {inspector}, we confirm the {kind} on {date}. Scope: {scope}. Please tell us which records you need and we will have them ready.
mt: Hallo, we bevestigen dat er een melding is.

en: Revenue from sales was {col:pnl.revenue} and grants received were {col:pnl.grants}. Costs were {col:pnl.costs} and depreciation was {col:pnl.depreciation}.
mt: De inkomsten uit verkoop waren {col:pnl.revenue} en de ontvangen subsidies waren {col:pnl.grants}.

en: The result check shows: {col:pnl.state}. The figures come from the Cost Ledger, the Income Ledger, the grants and the asset register and are not audited.
mt: De cijfers zijn afkomstig uit de Kostenboek, de Inkomstenboek, de subsidies en het vermogensregister en zijn niet gecontroleerd.

en: Budget against actual report for a cost code
mt: Budget ten opzichte van feitelijk verslag voor een kostencode
why: too long: 61 characters, the limit is 60

en: Cost code: {col:budget.code} {col:budget.name}. Group: {col:budget.group}. Budget holder: {col:budget.manager}.
mt: Kostencode: {col:budget.code} {col:budget.name}. Groep: {col:budget.group}.

en: If costs continue at this pace the year will end at {col:budget.forecast}, which is {col:budget.gap} against the budget. The budget check shows: {col:budget.state}.
mt: Als de kosten in dit tempo doorgaan, zal het jaar eindigen op {col:budget.forecast}, wat {col:budget.gap} tegenover de begroting is.

en: The budget holder explains any difference and proposes action before the next monthly close. The budget was last reviewed on {col:budget.reviewed}.
mt: De begrotinghouder legt elk verschil uit en stelt maatregelen voor voor het einde van de volgende maand.

en: That is {col:fields.per_ha} per hectare and a margin of {col:fields.margin}. The result check shows: {col:fields.state}.
mt: Dat is {col:fields.per_ha} per hectare en een marge van {col:fields.margin}.

en: We expect running costs of {col:cash.running_out}, machines and works of {col:cash.capex_out}, owner drawings of {col:cash.drawings_out}, loan repayments of {col:cash.loan_out} and tax and licences of {col:cash.tax_out}, in total {col:cash.outflow}.
mt: We verwachten in totaal lopende kosten van {col:cash.running_out}, machines en werken van {col:cash.capex_out}, tekeningen van de eigenaar van {col:cash.drawings_out}, lening aflossingen van {col:cash.loan_out} en belastingen en vergunningen van {col:cash.tax_out}.

en: The net result of the month is {col:cash.net} and the closing cash is {col:cash.closing}, which covers {col:cash.cover_weeks} weeks of costs. The cash check shows: {col:cash.state}.
mt: Het netto resultaat van de maand is {col:cash.net} en het sluitingsgeld is {col:cash.closing}, dat {col:cash.cover_weeks} weken kosten dekt.

en: Lender: {col:loans.lender}. Loan: {col:loans.loan_id}, {col:loans.type}. Purpose: {col:loans.purpose}.
mt: Lening, doel, doel.

en: The amount borrowed was {col:loans.principal} at {col:loans.rate} per year, starting on {col:loans.start} and ending on {col:loans.maturity}. The payment is {col:loans.payment} each month.
mt: Het geleende bedrag was {col:loans.principal} bij {col:loans.rate} per jaar, beginnend op {col:loans.start} en eindigend op {col:loans.maturity}.

en: So far {col:loans.paid} of the principal has been repaid and the balance is {col:loans.balance}. The next payment is due on {col:loans.next_due}. The loan check shows: {col:loans.state}.
mt: De volgende betaling is verschuldigd op {col:loans.next_due}. De lening check toont aan: {col:loans.state}.

en: The loan is secured by: {col:loans.collateral}. The interest for the coming year on the balance is about {col:loans.interest_year}.
mt: De rente voor het komende jaar op het saldo is ongeveer {col:loans.interest_year}.

en: Event: {col:claims.event} on {col:claims.event_date}, field: {col:claims.field}. We reported it on {col:claims.reported}.
mt: Event: {col:claims.event} op {col:claims.event_date}, veld: {col:claims.field}.

en: Certificate or permit: {col:certs.name}. Kind: {col:certs.kind}. Issued by: {col:certs.body}.
mt: Certificaat of vergunning: {col:certs.name}.

en: It was issued on {col:certs.issued} and expires on {col:certs.expiry}, which is {col:certs.days_left} days from today. The expiry check shows: {col:certs.state}.
mt: Het is uitgegeven op {col:certs.issued} en verloopt op {col:certs.expiry}, dat is {col:certs.days_left} dagen vanaf vandaag.

en: It covers: {col:certs.scope}. The yearly fee is {col:certs.fee}.
mt: De jaarlijkse vergoeding bedraagt {col:certs.fee}.

en: The value after depreciation is {col:assets.book}. It was counted on {col:assets.counted_on} and the next count is on {col:assets.next_count}. The asset check shows: {col:assets.state}.
mt: De waarde na afschrijving is {col:assets.book}. Het werd geteld op {col:assets.counted_on} en de volgende telling is op {col:assets.next_count}.

en: Current assets were {col:ratios.current_assets} against current liabilities of {col:ratios.current_liabilities}, a current ratio of {col:ratios.current_ratio}. The quarter check shows: {col:ratios.state}.
mt: De lopende activa waren {col:ratios.current_assets} tegen lopende passiva van {col:ratios.current_liabilities}, een lopende verhouding van {col:ratios.current_ratio}.
